Prohibited items

US export laws restrict the transportation of any type of firearm, its parts and/or accessories, optical laser sights, optical binoculars and munitions. (The products of the mentioned type are destroyed immediately upon receipt in the warehouse or transferred to a special service). Parcels will not be forwarded to another address and will not be returned to the seller for shipping. The list of prohibited items includes:

1. Firearms

2. Pneumatic weapons (except 4.5 mm caliber without cylinders)

3. Jewelry made of precious stones, gold, silver, or other valuable materials

4. Crossbow/bow and arrow

5. Optical laser target

6. Optical target for combat purpose,

7. Explosive material

8. Poison-chemicals

9. Spray or some kind of pumped up balloon

10. Narcotic substances (also called bio flavorings)

11. Psychotropic drugs

12. Money

13. Magazines and catalogs

14. Any kind of flavoring

15. Pornographic products

16. Milk, meat, hay products

17. Animals and birds or their stuffed animals

18. Seed of any kind of plant, or plant, sapling and tree

19. Products containing flammable and explosive substances or liquids

20. Alcohol

21. Car/motorcycle oil and pumped cylinders/spray

22. Car airbags

23. Car/motorcycle or other mechanism shock absorbers

24. Car/motorcycle or other mechanism battery

25. Paints

Do not buy equipment containing liquid and oil without consulting our company's specialists. Allowed: (along with other usual products) - purchase of small quantities of food products, up to 4 liters of alcoholic beverages, up to 10 boxes of non-psychotropic, non-prescription medicines and up to 250 grams of tobacco products. Please read the prohibitions carefully, as the package cannot be returned or redirected. Please contact the support team for details.
